sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Repeal of the Agricultural Produce Markets Repeal Act 2004
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2004
ACT VII OF 2004
NORTH‑WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE REPEAL OF THE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (REPEAL) ACT, 2004
An Act to repeal
the North‑West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Markets (Repeal)
Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of N.‑W.
F.P. Extraordinary, 22nd October, 2004]
No.PA/NWFP/Legis.1/2004/28557,
dated 22-10‑2004.‑--The North-West Frontier Province Repeal of
the Agricultural Produce Markets .(Repeal) Bill, 2004, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of North‑West Frontier Province, on the 11th
October, 2004 and assented "to, by the Governor of the North‑West
Frontier Province on 16th October, 2004 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the North‑West Frontier Province.
Preamble.‑--Whereas
it is expedient to repeal the North‑West Frontier Province Agricultural
Produce Markets (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002 (N.‑W.F.P. Ord. No. XXXVIII of
2002), and to revive the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 (Pb. Act No. V
of 1939) as applicable in the North‑West Frontier Province immediately
before its repeal;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
1. Short title and
commencement.‑--(1) This Act may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Repeal of the Agricultural Produce Markets (Repeal) Act,
2004.
(2) It shall come into force at once
and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 5th October, 2002.

dated 22-10‑2004.‑--The North-West Frontier Province Repeal of
the Agricultural Produce Markets .(Repeal) Bill, 2004, having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of North‑West Frontier Province, on the 11th
October, 2004 and assented "to, by the Governor of the North‑West
Frontier Province on 16th October, 2004 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the North‑West Frontier Province.
Preamble.‑--Whereas
it is expedient to repeal the North‑West Frontier Province Agricultural
Produce Markets (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002 (N.‑W.F.P. Ord. No. XXXVIII of
2002), and to revive the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 (Pb. Act No. V
of 1939) as applicable in the North‑West Frontier Province immediately
before its repeal;
It is hereby enacted as follows:
2. Repeal of N.‑W.F.P.
Ord. No. XXXVIII of 2002 and revival of Pb. Act V of 1939.‑‑‑(1)
The North‑West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Markets (Repeal)
Ordinance, 2002 (N.‑W.F.P. Ord. No. XXXVIII of 2002), is hereby repealed
and shall be deemed to have been so repealed with effect from the 5th October,
2002, as if it had never come into force.
(2) Consequent upon the repeal of
the North‑West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce Markets (Repeal)
Ordinance, 2002 (N.‑W.F.P. Ord. No. XXXVIII of 2002), under subsection
(1), the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939 (Pb. Act No. V of 1939), as
applicable, in the North‑West Frontier Province immediately before its
repeal, shall stand revived and, for all intents and purposes be deemed to have
been so revived with effect from the 5th October, 2002, as if it had never been
repealed.
